Zuccini, Asparagus and Peppers Salad
By: gypsy696
Published: Sunday, November 28, 2010 - 8:41pm

Ingredients




Some asparagus (boiled for 2 minutes)
1/2 zuccini
1/2 a red pepper
1/2 a yellow pepper
1/2 a green pepper
1/2 a ripe tomato
3 small Indian aubergines (boiled for a minute)
Some lettuce leaves
Handful of olives
Spoonful of olive oil

Preparation

1 Start off with the chopped peppers and lettuce leaves 2 Add the boiled asparagus.... 3 Then the zuccini ...Its a shame to have boiled zuccini..So definitely have it raw.
